panels.title: Daemons ($period)
panels.description: One row per runtime daemon: liveness, halt state, the expert queue standing on disk right now (queued + active jobs across every expert of that repo), problem jobs now, errors and tokens over the selected period. Cost is an estimate: tokens priced at Anthropic list rates per model family (fable/mythos $10, opus $5, sonnet-5 $2, sonnet-4 $3, haiku $1 per 1M input; output 5x, cache read 0.1x, cache write 1.25x). Models outside those families count as $0.

targets.expr: (max by (repo) (lazycortex_runtime_dirty_tree{repo=~"$repo"}) or 0 * max by (repo) (lazycortex_runtime_build_info{repo=~"$repo"})) + 2 * (max by (repo) (lazycortex_runtime_daemon_halted{repo=~"$repo"}) or 0 * max by (repo) (lazycortex_runtime_build_info{repo=~"$repo"})) + 4 * (max by (repo) (lazycortex_runtime_daemon_paused{repo=~"$repo"}) or 0 * max by (repo) (lazycortex_runtime_build_info{repo=~"$repo"}))

sum by (repo) (
  increase(lazycortex_runtime_tokens_total{repo=~"$repo",model=~"claude-fable.*|claude-mythos.*",kind="input"}[$period]) * 1e-05
